V1 prototype: Built browser-based voice chat (koda-voice.pages.dev). Uses MediaRecorder → Cloudflare Workers AI Whisper → Clawdbot chat API → browser TTS. Works on desktop but iOS Safari has issues with Web Speech API (service-not-allowed) and audio format (MP4 vs WAV). Switched to raw PCM capture + WAV encoding. Partially working but not reliable enough for daily use.

Research phase: Investigated proper solutions. Pipecat (open-source voice AI framework by Daily.co) + SmallWebRTCTransport (free P2P WebRTC, no infrastructure cost) is the right approach. Uses WebRTC like Zoom — handles streaming audio, echo cancellation, interruptions natively. Deepgram offers $200 free credit (no expiry, no CC) for STT. Total ongoing cost after credits: ~$0.46/hr. Vapi evaluated but rejected ($0.13-0.31/min = another Twilio situation).
